import random, json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def make(nflows, nnodes, cap, equal_val=True, pathlen=None, seed=1):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    nodes=['n%02d'%i for i in range(nnodes)]
    caps=dict((n,cap) for n in nodes)
    flows=[]; offers={}
    H=9
    for i in range(nflows):
        k = pathlen or rng.randint(2,min(5,nnodes))
        path=rng.sample(nodes,k)
        kinds='KKKQTKKKK'[:H]
        tmpl=bytes([1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9])
        flows.append(dict(id='f%02d'%i,path=path,template=tmpl.hex(),kinds=kinds))
        q=4; ttl=20
        hdr=bytearray([1,2,3,0,0,7,0,0,0])
        hdr[3]=rng.randint(0,255); hdr[6]=ttl; hdr[5]=q
        cnt = 100 if equal_val else rng.randint(1,1000)
        offers['f%02d'%i]=[dict(header=bytes(hdr).hex(),count=cnt)]
    return dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=0,pinned=[],offers=offers)

def dfs_ref(req, limit=None):
    """Independent exhaustive enumeration of feasible sets (reference)."""
    R=m.parse_request(req); F=R['flows']
    ids=sorted(F)
    ben={fid:m.flow_benefit(F[fid],R['runs'][fid],R['warmup']) for fid in F}
    caps=R['caps']
    pinned=set(R['pinned'])
    n=len(ids)
    best=None
    count=0
    # DFS over include/exclude with capacity tracking only (no value bound)
    usage={n2:0 for n2 in caps}
    def rec(i,v,c,sel):
        nonlocal best,count
        count+=1
        if i==n:
            key=(v,-c)
            if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,tuple(sel),v)
            return
        fid=ids[i]
        if fid in pinned:
            ok=True
            for nd in F[fid]['path']:
                if usage[nd]+1>caps[nd]: ok=False;break
            if not ok: return
            for nd in F[fid]['path']: usage[nd]+=1
            rec(i+1,v+ben[fid],c+1,sel+(fid,))
            for nd in F[fid]['path']: usage[nd]-=1
            return
        for nd in F[fid]['path']:
            if usage[nd]+1>caps[nd]:
                rec(i+1,v,c,sel); return
        for nd in F[fid]['path']: usage[nd]+=1
        rec(i+1,v+ben[fid],c+1,sel+(fid,))
        for nd in F[fid]['path']: usage[nd]-=1
        rec(i+1,v,c,sel)
    rec(0,0,0,())
    return best,count

rng=random.Random(12345)
worst=0
for trial in range(12):
    cap=rng.choice([1,2,3])
    nn=rng.choice([3,4,5,6])
    req=make(22,nn,cap,equal_val=(trial%2==0),seed=trial)
    st=time.time(); got=m.respond(req); el=time.time()-st
    worst=max(worst,el)
    ref,cnt=dfs_ref(req)
    ok = got['saved']==ref[2] and -ref[0][1]==len(got['selected'])
    print('trial',trial,'cap',cap,'nodes',nn,'t=%.3f'%el,'got',got['saved'],len(got['selected']),'ref',ref[2],-ref[0][1],'OK' if ok else 'MISMATCH','refnodes',cnt)
print('worst %.2fs'%worst)
PYEOF
